timeline.summary: Ashoka Buildcon redeemed ₹100 Cr of Series III NCDs in full on April 23, 2026.
Ashoka Buildcon subscribed to a ₹14.52 Cr rights issue in its wholly owned subsidiary Ashoka Baswantpur Singnodi Road Private Limited on April 29, 2026.
Ashoka Buildcon received a Provisional Certificate for 50.570 KMs aggregate on its Tumkur-Shivamogga NHAI HAM project.
Ashoka Buildcon Limited schedules Q4 FY2026 earnings call on May 22, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST with Managing Director Satish Parakh and CFO Paresh Mehta.
Ashoka Buildcon reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,771.87 Cr and PAT of ₹48.86 Cr, with an unmodified audit opinion.
Ashoka Buildcon declared an unmodified audit opinion for its FY26 financial statements on May 21, 2026.
Ashoka Buildcon released its Q4FY26 investor presentation reporting an order book of ₹15,312 Cr.
On May 27, 2026, Ashoka Buildcon filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for 20% revenue growth in FY27.
Ashoka Buildcon fully redeemed ₹100 Cr of commercial papers on October 19, 2026.
Ashoka Buildcon subsidiary received Provisional Certificate for completion of full 47.196 KM stretch of Tumkur Shivamogga Package-III HAM project.
ICRA reaffirmed and withdrew Ashoka Buildcon's '[ICRA]A1+' short-term debt rating at the company's request.
Ashoka Buildcon Limited scheduled a conference call for analysts and investors to discuss Q2 FY2027 results on 06-11-2026 at 1:00 pm IST.
